entry: path constraint timeline family (readSkeletonData caller block B13 0x28de74-0x28e060 plus the 0x28e52c/0x28ea74 islands)
scope: Reconstructed path-timeline C only: real Json_getFloat, real readCurve, real _spSkeletonJson_setError/spAnimation_dispose/spSkeletonData_dispose, the count-snapshot / array-reload / pointer-equality index scan into the shared [sp+0x2c] cell, the position/spacing dispatch with both scale selects, the shared frame loop and the two-float publish tail. Synthetic boundaries: spSkeletonData_findPathConstraint (scripted pointer, NULL allowed), spPathConstraintPosition/SpacingTimeline_create and the single Position setFrame (argument recorders whose store shape follows the disassembled bodies), spCurveTimeline_setStepped/setCurve recorders, fixture heap + allocator roster, libc providers, hand-built Json nodes. B17 (path mix, 0x28e8ec-0x28ea88) is NOT modelled; the driver reports the handoff. Not an original-equivalence claim.

b13_islands: 0x28e52c-0x28e558 (spacing dispatch + create + mode select; address-wise inside census B15)
0x28e554 + 0x28ea74-0x28ea7c (the 1.0f arm and the spacing scale; 0x28ea74 is inside census B17)
boundary.b17_evidence: own loop head 0x28e948, own readCurve call site 0x28e9b0, three-float frame stride 0x28e9e8 add r2,r2,r2,lsl#1, own keys "time"/"rotateMix"(as the +4 suffix "teMix")/"translateMix" at pools 0x28eb10/0x28eb14/0x28eb18, and its own publish tail 0x28e9cc..0x28ea0c
